text: EFFIS Fire Weather Index peaks at 22.9 — 'high' on the EFFIS scale — at Bujaraloz (stage 18) on 2026-11-26, across a 3-day forecast from 2026-11-25. 3 stage endpoint(s) reach 'high' (>= 21.3) or worse: Bujaraloz (stage 18) 23, Fuentes de Ebro (stage 16) 23, Candasnos (stage 19) 23. FWI anomaly at Bujaraloz is +3.0 versus the seasonal norm. Reported because: reminder. Classes: low <11.2, moderate 11.2-21.3, high 21.3-38, very high 38-50, extreme 50-70, very extreme >70.
